regions.full_page: As to the other -- the climax of irreligion and of plasphmey -- atheism: Webster rightly gives just its first meaning in its right place: "Denial of God's existence pr refusal to believe in Him. Then he goes on for a quarter of a colemn with learned expoanations and references, all good as far as they go; but Webster As to the otheher; - the climax of irreligion and of blasphemy- Atheism: Webster first and rightly gives the plain, simple meaning of the word: "The denial of God's existence or; refusal to believe in Him." Then he goes on with learned references of a quarter of a column, interesting in its way. But as refered to above, Webster himself seems lame in his grasp of religion and, like the big majority of the Hon. members of our Suprem Court, without a proper conception of what religion really means, can not possibly have a proper conception of the real monstrosity of atheism. Otherwise he as well as the Supreme Court would never make so little of religion or let atheism -- its would-be destruction -- of so easy. Atheism is the climax of intellectual and moral insanity -- the hopeless conclusion and desperate refuge at once of shallow thinking, of degenerate minds and of damm fools. No other their prime leader than Lucifer himself, -- himself the prince out- standing of diabolical deceivers, and by God's permission, dicta- tor in Hell's kingdom.

regions.full_page: To every normally thinking mind, atheism, by its very nature has always been considered nothing less than a blasphmous suggestion of the devil. This, however, does not exactly cap the monster. For whereas man's purpose as a rational creature, is to recognize and to know his Creator, so as to be able, intelligently to love Him, confidently to hope in Him and gratefully to serve Him, this monster atheism, by try- ing to weaken belief in God and the supernatural and rob us entirely of holy faith in Almighty God, would poison and nihilize everything per- taining to these virtues so essentiao to man's happiness, by blinding us to their divine Source and brazenly denying the very existenc of a Creator.
